title: Sales Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities 1. Sales & Revenue Management Own and drive the sales target for the assigned region/segment. Develop and execute strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. Identify new business opportunities across enterprise and mid-market customers. Drive new customer acquisition and business growth. Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. Track sales performance, conversion rates, deal velocity, and revenue forecasts. Ensure consistent achievement of assigned sales KPIs. 2. Enterprise & SaaS Sales Drive end-to-end sales of SaaS and enterprise technology solutions. Understand customer business requirements and map them to appropriate solutions. Conduct consultative selling with CXO-level and senior business stakeholders. Manage complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers. Build strong relationships with procurement, finance, IT, supply chain, operations, and senior management teams. Handle product demonstrations, solution presentations, commercial discussions, negotiations, and closures. Develop account penetration strategies for existing enterprise customers. 3. Team Management & Leadership Manage, mentor, and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and team targets. Set clear goals and KPIs for team members. Conduct regular pipeline reviews and performance discussions. Coach team members on prospecting, qualification, negotiation, objection handling, and closing. Identify performance gaps and provide appropriate guidance and support. Foster a performance-driven and collaborative sales culture. 4. Lead Generation & Business Development Develop strategies for generating qualified enterprise leads. Work closely with marketing and business development teams to improve lead generation. Identify target accounts and key decision-makers. Build relationships through networking, industry events, referrals, partnerships, and outbound prospecting. Develop strategic account plans for high-value prospects. 5. Client Relationship Management Build and maintain long-term relationships with key customers. Act as a senior point of contact during critical stages of the sales cycle. Understand customer challenges, business priorities, and future requirements. Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities. Ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation/customer success teams. 6. Sales Forecasting & Reporting Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reports. Provide regular updates to senior management on sales performance. Track opportunities through the CRM system. Analyse pipeline health, win/loss ratios, sales cycles, and revenue projections. Prepare periodic sales reports and management dashboards. 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Product, Presales, Implementation, Customer Success, Finance, and Marketing teams. Coordinate with presales teams for solution presentations and RFP/RFQ responses. Work with internal stakeholders to ensure commercial and contractual requirements are addressed. Provide market and customer feedback to the Product and Leadership teams. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, or a related field. 6+ years of relevant experience in B2B/SaaS/Enterprise Sales. Prior experience in a Sales Manager / Team Lead / Sales Leadership role. Proven experience in managing and achieving sales targets. Strong exposure to Enterprise Sales and consultative selling . Experience selling SaaS, technology products, enterprise applications, procurement technology, supply chain solutions, ERP, or similar B2B technology solutions will be preferred. Strong understanding of the complete enterprise sales lifecycle. Experience managing CXO-level and senior stakeholder relationships. With 1,000+ families successfully assisted, we are a trusted and high-performance property advisory brand in Bengaluru. 
 Job Summary: 
We are looking for a motivated, client-centric, and target-driven Sales Executive to join our growing team. You will be responsible for managing inbound and outbound leads, conducting property consultations, arranging site visits, and closing deals - all while delivering a premium client experience that reflects the Homz N Space standard. This is a front-facing sales role. We need someone who can build trust quickly, understand client needs deeply, and convert interest into decisions - with confidence and professionalism. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
1. Engage with inbound leads from digital platforms, walk-ins, referrals, and developer campaigns.
2. Understand client requirements - budget, location preferences, property type, configuration, and timeline. 3. Present and recommend suitable residential or commercial properties from our active project portfolio.
4. Schedule and conduct property site visits, ensuring a premium and well-organised experience for clients.
5. Follow up consistently with prospects via calls, WhatsApp, and in-person meetings to move them through the sales funnel.
6. Coordinate with developer partners for project updates, pricing revisions, inventory availability, and offers.
7. Share proposals, brochures, payment plans, and relevant project documentation with clients.
8. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets as defined by the Sales Manager.
9. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all leads, conversations, visits, and deal statuses in the CRM.
10. Build long-term client relationships that lead to referrals, repeat enquiries, and positive word-of-mouth.
11. Attend developer briefings, project launches, and channel partner events to stay updated on new inventory and market trends.
12. Collaborate with the marketing team on lead generation campaigns, social media enquiries, and event follow-ups. 
 Required Skills: 
1. Strong verbal communication in English and Kannada / Hindi - confident, clear, and persuasive.
2. Presentable, professional, and comfortable engaging with HNI and senior decision-makers.
3. Target-oriented mindset with a proactive and self-driven approach to work.
4. Basic proficiency in MS Office, WhatsApp Business, and CRM tools
5. Ability to explain project details, payment structures, and legal terms in simple language.
6. Good listening skills and ability to understand unstated client concerns.
7. Comfortable with field work - site visits, client meetings, and developer office interactions.
8. Own vehicle preferred for client meetings and site visit coordination. 
 Eligibility: 
1. 0 to 2 years of sales experience; real estate, banking, insurance, luxury retail, or hospitality preferred.
2. Any Graduate - degree in Business, Marketing, or related field is a plus but not mandatory.
3. Prior experience in channel partner sales or developer-side sales is an advantage.
4. Candidates with a strong network and existing client base are preferred.
5. Immediate or early joiners preferred. 
 What's In It For You: 
1. Competitive fixed salary with high-performance incentives - uncapped earning potential.
2. Access to premium Category-A developer inventory across Bengaluru's top micro-markets.
3. Structured onboarding, product training, and ongoing sales skill development.
4. Exposure to luxury project launches, HNI clients, and premium brand campaigns.
5. Clear growth path - Sales Executive - Senior Executive - Team Lead - Sales Manager.
6. A high-energy, collaborative, and performance-driven team culture - Recognition and rewards for top performers each quarter.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Start up
description:
We are looking for a high-energy Senior Sales Manager to own seller acquisition and grow the supply side of our marketplace across a defined micro-market. 
 About the Role At Truva, Seller Acquisitions means bringing property owners onto the Truva platform. This is a sales and business-development rolenot a finance or M&A acquisitions role . 
 You will identify homeowners looking to sell, pitch Truva as an alternative to traditional brokers, negotiate onboarding terms, and manage the seller relationship through the property-selling journey. Think of this role as owning the supply side of the marketplace for your assigned cluster . 
 Key Responsibilities Own seller-acquisition targets for a defined micro-market/cluster. Identify and build a pipeline of homeowners who are looking to sell their properties. Conduct outbound prospecting, cold calls, field visits, and in-person pitches. Clearly communicate Truva’s value proposition and differentiate it from traditional brokerage models. Negotiate commercial terms and convert prospects into onboarded sellers. Act as the primary point of contact for sellers throughout the onboarding and selling process. Address seller queries, concerns, and escalations proactively. Maintain a healthy and predictable pipeline to consistently achieve listing targets. Develop strong relationships within the assigned locality and build a sustainable source of seller leads. Track sales metrics, conversion rates, pipeline movement, and cluster performance. Work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth seller experience from acquisition through sale. What We're Looking For 3-6 years of experience in sales, business development, field sales, real estate, or a related customer-facing role. Strong preference for candidates with real-estate sales or field-sales experience . Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills. Comfortable with cold outreach, field visits, and face-to-face sales conversations . Strong customer-first mindset with a genuine interest in solving customer problems. High ownership and an entrepreneurial approach to achieving targets. Resilient and comfortable handling rejection, objections, and long sales cycles. Strong follow-through and relationship-management skills. Ability to work independently and build a business within a defined micro-market. Willingness to work 6 days a week and spend significant time in the field. 
 What Success Looks Like Consistently achieving seller-acquisition and listing targets. Building a strong, high-quality seller pipeline within the assigned cluster. Improving prospect-to-listing conversion through effective pitching and negotiation. Creating strong seller relationships and delivering a high-quality onboarding experience. Establishing Truva as a trusted alternative to traditional brokerage within the assigned micro-market. 
 Why Join Truva? Join an early-stage startup transforming the Indian residential real-estate experience. Work closely with a high-calibre founding team. Take end-to-end ownership of a critical marketplace function. Build deep expertise across sales, business development, and real estate. High-impact role with significant scope to grow as the company scales.

Job Description Regional Sales Manager (Bionic Hand Sales) Position Summary The Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding market penetration, and achieving regional sales targets for the KalArm portfolio. The role requires building strong relationships with Prosthetists & Orthotists (P&O), HCPs rehabilitation centers and hospitals. While ensuring consistent conversion of opportunities into successful installations. Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to expand market share and maximize revenue. Generate a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, referrals, networking, digital outreach and field visits. Drive the complete sales cycle from lead generation to product demonstration, commercial negotiation, order closure, and post-sales follow-up. Identify new business opportunities across hospitals, rehabilitation centers, prosthetic clinics and insurance providers.

Build long-term relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and clinical decision-makers. Deliver compelling clinical and commercial presentations highlighting the functional, technological, and economic benefits of the KalArm product portfolio. Educate healthcare professionals on patient selection, clinical outcomes, and rehabilitation protocols. Organize product demonstrations, clinical workshops, CMEs, and awareness programs to increase product adoption. Account Management Develop and manage strategic accounts to ensure repeat business and long-term partnerships. Maintain high customer satisfaction by ensuring timely responses, effective coordination, and excellent after-sales support. Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding product adoption within existing accounts. Resolve customer concerns promptly while coordinating with clinical, technical, and service teams. Market Development Conduct market intelligence on competitors, pricing, customer preferences, reimbursement opportunities, and emerging technologies. Develop regional expansion strategies to increase product visibility and market penetration. Represent the company at conferences, exhibitions, workshops, prosthetic conferences, and medical events. Reporting & Performance Management Maintain an accurate CRM and update sales activities, customer interactions, and opportunity status regularly. Submit weekly sales reports, pipeline reviews, forecasts, and territory development plans. Monitor conversion ratios, sales performance, revenue generation, and profitability against assigned KPIs. Work closely with Marketing, Clinical, Production, and Customer Support teams to improve customer experience and accelerate sales closures. B. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. Number of KalArm products sold. Lead generation and pipeline value. Lead-to-order conversion rate. Number of hospital, clinic, and P&O visits per month. Number of product demonstrations and clinical presentations conducted. New hospital and rehabilitation centre onboarding. Repeat orders and customer retention. Average sales cycle duration. Collection efficiency and payment realization. Customer satisfaction and post-installation follow-up compliance. Required Skills & Competencies Strong consultative and solution-based selling skills. Proven ability to consistently exceed sales targets. Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills. Strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement abilities. Commercial acumen with a customer-first approach. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Analytical mindset with experience in sales forecasting and pipeline management. Self-driven, target-oriented, and willing to travel extensively across the assigned region. Strong problem-solving, planning, and execution capabilities. C. Preferred Experience 6–10 years of medical device/pharma, prosthetics, orthotics, rehabilitation technology, healthcare, or capital equipment sales experience. Strong network among hospitals, rehabilitation centres, Prosthetists & Orthotists, PM&R specialists, and healthcare institutions. Develop business cases, opportunity assessment reports, management presentations and periodic BD pipeline/MIS reports. Represent the company at industry conferences, exhibitions, customer meetings, investor/developer meetings and renewable energy forums to strengthen market presence and identify new opportunities. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. EY - GDS Consulting - AI DATA - Sales Support executive (Senior Manager) The opportunity The Sales Support executive (Senior Manager) is a key contributor to Consulting growth, responsible for supporting sales pursuits, proposal execution, and commercial analysis across priority opportunities. This role works closely with Senior Managers, Partners, Account Leaders, and solution teams to improve pursuit effectiveness, deal quality, and pipeline discipline. Your key responsibilities Sales Pursuit Support Support end to end sales pursuits for consulting opportunities, including qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and approvals. Partner with pursuit leaders to help shape deal strategy, solution positioning, and client value propositions. Maintain strong discipline on pipeline tracking, win probability updates, and pursuit milestones. Proposal RFP Management Manage and coordinate RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and client presentations under guidance of Senior Managers and Partners. Work with cross functional teams (solution architects, finance, legal, risk, delivery) to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely submissions. Consolidate inputs, track dependencies, and ensure alignment between scope, commercials, and delivery approach. Commercial Financial Analysis Support pricing models, effort estimates, margin analysis, and financial summaries for consulting deals. Assist in preparing business cases, deal review materials, and approval documentation. Analyse deal economics and highlight commercial risks, assumptions, and improvement opportunities. Sales Operations Governance Ensure compliance with sales governance, review checkpoints, and approval workflows. Support maintenance of sales support templates, trackers, and standard documentation. Identify process gaps and contribute to continuous improvement of sales support operations. Stakeholder Management Act as a primary working level contact for account teams and pursuit stakeholders. Provide clear, structured updates on pursuit status, risks, and next steps. Support leadership in pipeline reviews, forecast updates, and performance reporting. Team Collaboration Capability Building Mentor Senior Consultants and Consultants within the sales support team. Share best practices on proposal writing, commercial structuring, and pursuit management. Contribute to knowledge assets, playbooks, and reusable pursuit collateral. Required Skills Experience Experience 15+ years of experience in consulting sales support, pursuit management, commercial advisory, or related roles. Hands on experience supporting medium to large consulting deals across technology, data, digital, or transformation programs. Experience working in a global / matrixed consulting environment is preferred. Should have strong AI understanding Core Competencies Strong understanding of the consulting sales lifecycle and proposal processes. Working knowledge of pricing, effort estimation, and commercial constructs. Ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear, client ready deliverables. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. Behavioural Leadership Skills Detail oriented with strong execution discipline. Comfortable operating in fast paced, deadline driven pursuit environments. Collaborative team player with emerging leadership capabilities. High standards of quality, compliance, and professionalism. Education Bachelor s degree required; MBA or equivalent is an advantage. What we look for People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment What working at EY offers At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you EY | Building a better working world

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth by acquiring new clients and expanding existing accounts for RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing), Permanent Staffing, Contract Staffing and Payroll Management Services . The role requires a strong understanding of the staffing and HR services industry, consultative selling capabilities, excellent client relationship management skills, and the ability to independently manage the complete business development cyclefrom lead generation and prospecting to proposal, negotiation, closure and account handover. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Business Development & Client Acquisition 
 Identify and develop new business opportunities for RPO, permanent staffing and payroll services. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients across industries. Conduct market mapping to identify target companies, decision-makers and potential staffing requirements. Generate leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, networking, references, industry events and existing relationships. Develop relationships with CXOs, CHROs, HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Heads, Procurement Heads and Business Leaders. Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate staffing / HR solutions. Own the complete sales cycle from lead generation to commercial closure. 
 RPO Business Development 
 Identify organizations with significant or recurring recruitment requirements and position RPO as a strategic talent acquisition solution. Develop customized RPO proposals based on client hiring volumes, locations, job categories, turnaround time and recruitment complexity. Present RPO solutions, operating models, SLAs, governance structures and commercials to prospective clients. Work with internal recruitment and operations teams to develop implementation plans for new RPO accounts. Track industry trends and competitor offerings in the RPO market. 
 Permanent Staffing / Recruitment Services 
 Acquire new clients requiring permanent recruitment and executive / professional hiring services. Understand manpower plans, hiring volumes, job specifications and recruitment challenges of clients. Develop recruitment mandates across functions and levels. Negotiate recruitment fees, replacement terms, payment terms and commercial agreements. Drive repeat business and increase wallet share from existing clients. 
 Payroll Services 
 Develop business opportunities for outsourced payroll and payroll management services. Understand client requirements around payroll processing, statutory compliance, employee data management, payroll reporting and HR administration. Position payroll outsourcing solutions based on client size, employee strength, locations and complexity. Coordinate with payroll / operations teams to prepare proposals, solution designs and commercials. Develop long-term relationships with clients to drive renewals and additional business. 
 Client Relationship Management 
 Build strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers. Conduct regular client meetings and business reviews. Understand client satisfaction levels and identify opportunities for service improvement. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across RPO, permanent staffing, payroll and other HR services. Ensure smooth transition of newly acquired accounts to the operations / delivery team. 
 Proposal, Commercials & Negotiation 
 Prepare business proposals, presentations, capability decks, RFP / RFQ responses and commercial proposals. Work with internal teams to develop accurate pricing and solution models. Negotiate commercials, SLAs, payment terms and contractual conditions with clients. Ensure that all commercial proposals meet the company's profitability and business objectives. Maintain accurate records of opportunities, proposals, closures and revenue forecasts. 
 Sales Target & Performance Management 
 Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue and business acquisition targets. Maintain a healthy sales funnel and provide accurate sales forecasts. Track lead-to-conversion ratios, sales cycle, average deal value and revenue realization. Regularly report business development activities, pipeline and closures to management. Take ownership of revenue generation and new client acquisition. 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
 Strong B2B business development and consultative selling skills. Good understanding of RPO, staffing, recruitment and payroll outsourcing models. Proven experience in selling HR / staffing / recruitment services. Strong client acquisition and relationship management capabilities. Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to engage with senior HR and business stakeholders. Strong commercial and financial understanding. Ability to prepare business proposals and presentations. Strong networking and lead-generation capabilities. Target-oriented and highly result-driven. Ability to work independently and manage the complete sales cycle. Good knowledge of CRM / sales management tools. 
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, HR or Business Management would be preferred. 
 Experience 
 5-10 years of relevant experience in business development / sales within: RPO services Recruitment / permanent staffing Contract staffing Payroll outsourcing HR consulting / HR services Recruitment consulting Workforce management services
